answer: The strongest sybil defense is influence as a function of account age times honest epochs. Each agent accrues reputation slowly by attesting honestly across the bridge between networks; new accounts start at zero velocity, so mass-creating fake identities in the open lagoon of trade lanes buys no votes or routes. An attacker must keep each sockpuppet online for months, staking escrow slashed on fraud. Faking identity becomes a slow capital-locked loan yielding nothing until maturity and burning jade-tier reputation on one slip, so sybils cost far more than honesty ever would.
